title: ci: pin credential-holding third-party actions by sha, and pass the Turbo cache credentials only to merge-queue and main runs
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoRyAStcu3CV5kiXeCX564xD)_

CI supply-chain hardening, two commits that can land or be dropped independently:

1. **Pin the credential-holding third-party actions by commit sha** (`96212c2`).
2. **Pass the Turbo remote-cache credentials only to merge-queue and main runs** (`7ea2af7`).

## 1. Third-party actions pinned by sha

Each names the commit its floating major resolved to when this was written (read with `git ls-remote` against the upstream repository), with a trailing version comment, the form `release.yml` already uses for `changesets/action`.

| workflow | action | was | now | credential in reach |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `docker-publish.yml` | `docker/setup-qemu-action` | `@v4` | `99012661954931238ded8c8b007157a8430204e1` # v4.4.0 | `packages: write` job |
| `docker-publish.yml` | `docker/setup-buildx-action` | `@v4` | `f87e5991a6d7451dcb8d9637bfbc97413f497069` # v4.4.1 | `packages: write` job |
| `docker-publish.yml` | `docker/login-action` | `@v4` | `81c6f93d4bc991e510b342a00b419b3bb4efc5c6` # v4.7.0 | `GITHUB_TOKEN` as registry password |
| `docker-publish.yml` | `docker/metadata-action` | `@v6` | `dc802804100637a589fabce1cb79ff13a1411302` # v6.2.0 | `packages: write` job |
| `docker-publish.yml` | `docker/build-push-action` | `@v7` | `c3c9e263c25d99ce0380d002d59b67737d91b0dc` # v7.4.0 | pushes with the logged-in registry credential |
| `check-links.yml` (2 steps) | `lycheeverse/lychee-action` | `@v2` | `e7477775783ea5526144ba13e8db5eec57747ce8` # v2.9.0 | `token` input defaults to the job token |
| `ci.yml` (filter job) | `dorny/paths-filter` | `@v4` | `ceb8a2b8f2d89434be7ff52d3de7ec3738c5cc9d` # v4.0.3 | `token` input defaults to the job token |

Already pinned and untouched: `changesets/action` (`release.yml`), `google/osv-scanner-action` (`validate-deps.yml`). Left on tags: first-party `actions/*` and `github/codeql-action` (GitHub-owned); `pnpm/action-setup` in `showcase-smoke.yml` receives no credential. The readers of the paths-filter ref (`check-ci-filter-parity.mjs`, `dispatch-gates.mjs`) match the action by prefix, so a pinned ref reads the same.

## 2. Turbo remote-cache credentials scoped by event

Before: every same-repo `pull_request` run received `TURBO_TOKEN` and `TURBO_REMOTE_CACHE_SIGNATURE_KEY`. The read-only `remote:r` setting is turbo client configuration; the token itself can write and the key can sign, so any code a PR runs during its build could upload a signed artifact that a later queue or main build replays.

After, in all twelve carriers (`ci.yml` ×7, `lint.yml` ×5), both secrets are gated on the same condition:

```yaml
TURBO_TOKEN: ${{ (github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && secrets.TURBO_REMOTE_CACHE_SIGNATURE_KEY != '' && secrets.TURBO_TOKEN || '' }}
TURBO_REMOTE_CACHE_SIGNATURE_KEY: ${{ (github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && secrets.TURBO_REMOTE_CACHE_SIGNATURE_KEY || '' }}
```

- Credentialed: `merge_group`, and every run on `refs/heads/main` (push, the hourly schedule, `workflow_dispatch` on main). Not credentialed: `pull_request`, and a dispatch on any other branch. `TURBO_CACHE` and `TURBO_TEAM` are unchanged, so the write rule is exactly as before.
- **Measured question, PR reads with or without the secrets:** Vercel's remote cache authenticates reads as well as writes, and with `remoteCache.signature: true` turbo needs the key to verify a download, which is the same key that signs. So a PR run cannot read the remote without holding both; the answer is **not at all**. A PR run builds from the restored Actions-cache seed (`local:rw`), which `main` saves. ⚠️ I could not reach `api.vercel.com` from this container (egress refused), so the "reads need the token" half is read from turbo's behaviour as `assert-turbo-remote-cache.mjs` already documents it (any of the three unset turns the remote off), not from a live probe; this PR's own CI run is the first live reading.
- Cost, measured on this PR's own runs. With the remote withheld, a PR build reads only the Actions seed `main` saves:
  - At `7ea2af7` (00:27Z, before PR #25523 landed): Build Core `76 build task(s) -- 0 remote hit(s), 0 local hit(s), 76 miss(es)`, build step 6 m 4 s. A credentialed PR in the same window read 53 remote / 0 local / 23 miss (1 m 40 s), so the seed was contributing nothing to anyone, most likely because the 2.4 GB Test Core seed snowball (#25452) was flushing the 10 GB pool on every merge.
  - At `945502c` (01:34Z, after PR #25523, the merge of main): Build Core `76 build task(s) -- 0 remote hit(s), 76 local hit(s), 0 miss(es)`, build step 911 ms, entirely from the seed.
  - So with the pool no longer churned, a PR build no longer needs the remote. What remains is seed lag: tasks whose inputs changed in merges that landed after the newest seed was saved rebuild cold. The `assert-turbo-remote-cache` notice prints the local-hit count on every PR run, so a regression is visible in the log.
- `assert-turbo-remote-cache.mjs` gains `isCredentialedRun()` (same condition) and reports a disabled remote on a non-credentialed run as a `notice` ("withheld by design"), not a warning. Writing runs still red when the remote is off. New self-test battery `credentialed run` (5 cases): 37 cases across 7 batteries, exit 0.
- Build Core's "Credentials" comment, the authority the other carriers point back to, is rewritten to the new rule.

## Verification

Gates derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `7ea2af7`; results under "Gates" below.

### Gates (local, head `7ea2af7`)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived **70** families from the diff; **66 exit 0**; **4 NOT MEASURED** (exit 3, prerequisite: they read built `dist/`, and no package source is in this diff): `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`. CI runs them on a real build.
- Reconciled: `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reports "70 derived families accounted for — 66 run, 4 NOT-MEASURED", exit 0.
- Among the 66 green: `check:ci-filter-parity` (+ self-test), `check:required-contexts`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:select-gate-families`, `check:self-test-wired`, `check:workflow-step-name-quoting`, `check:nul-bytes`, and `assert-turbo-remote-cache.mjs --self-test` (37 cases, 7 batteries).
- No changeset: the diff touches `.github/workflows/**` and `scripts/ci/**`, which no package publishes (`skip-changeset`).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么**:①CI 里拿得到凭据的第三方 action(docker 发布五个、lychee、paths-filter)改为按提交 sha 钉死;②Turbo 远程缓存的 token 和签名密钥只给合并队列和 main 上的运行,PR 运行不再拿到。
- **为什么改**:浮动标签可以被上游重指,下一次运行就把凭据交给未经审阅的代码;PR 里跑的任何代码(包括新加依赖的安装脚本)此前都握着 main 信任的缓存签名密钥。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:PR 构建不再读远程缓存,只读 main 存下的 Actions 缓存种子。实测:#25523 落地前种子被挤掉,PR 的 Build Core 0 命中、6 分 4 秒;#25523 落地后本 PR 的 Build Core 76/76 全部命中种子、构建 0.9 秒。剩余代价是种子之后新合并改动过的包需要冷构建。回滚:单独 revert 第二个提交即可,第一个提交独立成立。
- **席位意见**:
- **你要做的**:第②条已于 2026-10-24 裁定采用(收回凭据并依赖 Actions 种子);批准后由席位落地。本 PR 保持 draft。
